description: Figure: Gpm3 active-site geometry versus Gpm1 substrate pocket, model confidence and PAE around the insertions
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, json
df=pd.read_csv("gpm3_activesite_distances.csv")
pae=json.load(open("AF_Gpm3_Q12326_pae.json"))
P=np.array(pae[0]["predicted_aligned_error"]) if isinstance(pae,list) else np.array(pae["predicted_aligned_error"])
# pLDDT per residue
pl={}
for L in open("AF_Gpm3_Q12326.pdb"):
    if L.startswith("ATOM") and L[12:16].strip()=="CA": pl[int(L[22:26])]=float(L[60:66])
res=np.array(sorted(pl)); v=np.array([pl[i] for i in res])
ins=[(8,12,"+5"),(51,55,"+5"),(82,101,"+20"),(107,109,"+3"),(171,175,"+5"),(183,195,"+13"),(299,301,"+3")]
site={13:'R',14:'H',15:'G',16:'Q',17:'S',19:'L',20:'N',24:'I',25:'F',26:'C',70:'R',120:'E',123:'Y',
      131:'K',147:'R',148:'R',235:'H',237:'S',258:'D',261:'N'}

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(14,8.5))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,2,height_ratios=[1,1.25],width_ratios=[1.6,1])

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
x=np.arange(len(df))
ax.plot(x,df["Gpm1_d_3PG"],"o-",color="#4C72B0",label="Gpm1 crystal structure (1QHF, chain B)")
ax.plot(x,df["Gpm3_d_3PG"],"s-",color="#C44E52",label="Gpm3 AlphaFold model superposed on Gpm1")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(df["position"],rotation=55,ha="right",fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("side-chain min distance\nto bound 3-PGA, A")
ax.legend(fontsize=9); ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
ax.set_title("Gpm3 places every active-site side chain on the Gpm1 substrate pocket\nPhenix superpose_pdbs backbone RMSD 1.04 A over 199 atoms, median |difference| 0.83 A",fontsize=11)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
ax.plot(res,v,color="#333333",lw=0.9)
for a,b,lab in ins:
    ax.axvspan(a,b,color="#4C72B0",alpha=0.22)
    ax.text((a+b)/2,103,lab,ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#4C72B0")
for p in site: ax.plot([p],[pl.get(p,0)],marker="v",color="#C44E52",ms=5)
ax.axhline(70,color="grey",ls="--",lw=0.8)
ax.set_xlabel("Gpm3 residue (Q12326)"); ax.set_ylabel("AlphaFold pLDDT"); ax.set_ylim(30,108)
ax.set_title("Gpm3 model confidence; blue = insertions vs Gpm1, red triangles = active-site positions",fontsize=10)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
im=ax.imshow(P,cmap="Blues_r",vmin=0,vmax=31)
for a,b,lab in ins:
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((a,a),b-a,b-a,fill=False,ec="#C44E52",lw=1.2))
ax.set_title("Gpm3 predicted aligned error (A)",fontsize=10)
ax.set_xlabel("residue"); ax.set_ylabel("residue")
plt.colorbar(im,ax=ax,fraction=0.046)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print("mean pLDDT at the 20 active-site positions: %.1f" % np.mean([pl[p] for p in site if p in pl]))
print("mean pLDDT of the +20 insertion (82-101): %.1f" % np.mean([pl[i] for i in range(82,102) if i in pl]))
print("mean pLDDT of the +13 insertion (183-195): %.1f" % np.mean([pl[i] for i in range(183,196) if i in pl]))
print("mean PAE between insertion 82-101 and the catalytic core (13-26,70,120,235): %.1f A" %
      P[np.ix_(range(81,101),[12,13,14,15,16,18,19,23,24,25,69,119,234])].mean())
